INSERT INTO mk_ca_cf_mp_pq (dist_code, wo_no, area_code, amt_ym, other_col)
SELECT
    
    CASE WHEN random() < ? THEN ? ELSE lpad((floor(random()*?)::int)::text,?,?) END AS dist_code,
    
    ? || lpad((floor(random()*?)::int)::text,?,?) AS wo_no,
    
    ? || lpad((floor(random()*?)::int)::text,?,?) AS area_code,
    
    (ARRAY[?,?,?,?,?,?])[floor(random()*?)+?] AS amt_ym,
    
    ? || md5(random()::text) AS other_col
FROM generate_series(?, ?);
